prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic vertical professional lifestyle portrait of a young Black adult man seated confidently behind a polished wooden executive desk in a modern office, looking directly at the camera with a calm, focused, businesslike expression. He wears a crisp white dress shirt, a navy blue tie with tiny white dots, and a dark wristwatch, sitting in a tall black leather executive chair. His left hand holds a black corded telephone receiver to his ear, with the coiled cable leading off to the right, while his right hand writes with a black pen on a small yellow sticky note pad on the desk. The scene should feel like focus, confidence, and an important call in progress.

Use a realistic office background with a dark charcoal wall and a wooden bookshelf on the right containing exactly 4 black ring binders, a small potted plant, a row of orange-and-white books, and a black globe on an upper shelf. On the left wall, include a white crowned lion head logo above the brand text FACELESS CONTENT. Add exactly 5 productivity notes on the wall: 4 colored sticky notes and 1 checklist sheet. The 4 sticky notes must read: yellow note “PLAN - FOCUS - EXECUTE”, blue note “DISCIPLINE TODAY SUCCESS TOMORROW”, pink note “BE BETTER THAN YESTERDAY”, and green note “HARD WORK BEATS TALENT”. The checklist sheet must be titled “DAILY CHECKLIST” and list exactly 5 checked items: “MEETING”, “CALLS”, “EMAILS”, “PLANNING”, and “FOLLOW UP”.

On the desk, include exactly 6 visible work items: a black mug printed with three stacked words Discipline Focus Execution, a black calculator, a neat stack of multicolored sticky notes, the yellow note pad he is writing on, a clipboard document titled BUSINESS PLAN with simple charts, and an open silver laptop on the right edge. Use warm realistic lighting, sharp facial detail, natural skin texture, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, polished wood reflections, and a high-end corporate editorial photography style. Frame as a vertical 2:3 portrait, waist-up composition, subject centered, desk filling the lower third, no extra people, no surreal elements, no distorted hands, and no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的专业生活方式肖像，画面中 一位留着黑色短发、面容清爽、神情冷静自信且目光直视镜头的年轻黑人男性高管 坐在现代办公室里一张光洁的木质行政办公桌后。他坐姿端正，坐在一把高靠背黑色皮质办公椅上，身穿 一件挺括的白色衬衫，搭配一条带有白色小圆点的海军蓝领带，并佩戴一块黑色腕表。他的右手正用一支黑色钢笔在一张黄色便签纸上书写，左手将黑色有线电话听筒贴在耳边；电话线呈对角线延伸至办公桌右侧。氛围专注、严谨且具有商务感，仿佛他正在规划日程的同时接听重要电话。采用竖构图，使用写实的镜头视角，面部细节清晰，呈现自然的办公室光影、微妙的景深效果以及浓郁的暖色木质调。办公桌上需包含 6 组清晰可见的物品：1 个印有“Discipline / Focus / Execution”三行堆叠文字的黑色陶瓷马克杯、1 台计算器、1 叠包含蓝、粉、黄、绿多色的便签纸、1 张正在书写的黄色便签纸、1 个带有标题为“BUSINESS PLAN”且显示图表和线条文档的剪贴板，以及 1 台在右侧被截取的银色笔记本电脑。在他身后，设置一面哑光炭灰色墙壁，左侧印有白色狮头皇冠标志和品牌文字 FACELESS CONTENT。在墙上添加 4 张彩色方形便签纸：黄色便签写着“PLAN - FOCUS - EXECUTE”，蓝色便签写着“DISCIPLINE TODAY SUCCESS TOMORROW”，粉色便签写着“BE BETTER THAN YESTERDAY”，绿色便签写着“HARD WORK BEATS TALENT”。在墙上钉上 1 张白色的每日清单表，标题为 DAILY CHECKLIST，包含 5 个已勾选的项目：MEETING, CALLS, EMAILS, PLANNING, FOLLOW UP。背景右侧放置一个木质书架，上面摆放着活页夹、书籍、一盆小绿植以及一个黑色的球状装饰物。保持图像照片级真实、整洁、精致、励志且具有企业感；避免卡通风格、夸张的面部特征、杂乱、多余的人物、扭曲的手部、无法辨认的主要文字或水印。
